FAQs
Is Southern University Online accredited?
Southern Univeristy Online is part of Southern University and A&M College that offers its online degrees. Southern University and A&M College is accredited by Southern Association of Colleges and Schools Commission on Colleges to award baccalaureate, masters, and doctoral degrees. Contact the Commission regarding questions about the accreditation of the University at:
1866 Southern Lane
Decatur, GA, 30033
404-679-4500
https://www.subr.edu/subrinstitutionpage
Is Southern University authorized to operate in all 50 states?
Southern University and A&M College is approved by the State of Louisiana to participate in the National Council for State Authorization Reciprocity Agreements (NC-SARA, SARA-Louisiana). NC-SARA is a voluntary agreement that establishes comparable national standards for offering postsecondary distance education courses and programs.
Forty-nine (49) states (all except California) and the District of Columbia currently participate in NC-SARA. Though California is not a member of SARA, Southern University and A&M College is an accredited public, not for profit institution and may offer course work leading to a degree in the state of California.
Students are encouraged to check with the appropriate State agency before enrolling in any degree program.
Does Southern University Online offer graduate degrees?
Southern University Online offers both graduate and undergraduate degrees.
Graduate Degrees are:
MBA Online
Executive Masters in Public Administration
Executive Masters in Criminal Justice
Does Southern Universiry Online offer undergraduate degrees?
Southern University Online offers the following 100% online undergraduate degrees:
BS degree in Criminal Justice
BS degree in Psychology
BS degree in Interdisciplinary Studies
Are the classes in mini sessions or full semester sessions?
Most of the courses in the undergraduate and graduate programs are taught in 8-week mini sessions. However, the MBA Online courses are taught in the traditional 16-week full semester format.
How much does it cost to attend Southern University Online?
Tuition and fees are very affordable at Southern University Online. We do not charge separate fees for any of our degree programs. Is there an application fee for Southern University Online?
Beginning August 1, 2019, there is a $25.00 Application Fee for every student, including readmits, transfer students, and first time freshman. Application fees are not waived.
